<a name="payment-createtransaction"></a>
#### `->createTransaction()`

```php
public function createTransaction(
    $amount,
    $currency,
    $card,
    $receipt_email = null,
    $metadata = null,
    $description = '',
    $transfer = array(),
    $save = false
)
```

Creates a new payment transaction

**Parameters**

+ `$amount` `Integer`: defines the amount of the transaction in cents
+ `$currency` `string`: defines the currecy of the transaction
+ `$card` `Object`: takes the card object submitted
+ `$receipt_email` `string`, default `null`: takes the customer email
+ `$metadata` `string`, default `null`: defines the metadata information that can be passed on to the transaction
+ `$description` `string`, default `''`: defines the description that can be passed on to the transaction
+ `$transfer`, default `array()`
+ `$save` `boolean`, default `false`: defines whether the transaction should be saved or not for a particular customer

**Returns** `$result`: to report on the result of the creation

Source: [framework/core/Payment.php:76](https://github.com/caligrafy/caligrafy-quill/blob/v2.25.0/framework/core/Payment.php#L76)

<a name="payment-createpaymentintent"></a>
#### `->createPaymentIntent()`

```php
public function createPaymentIntent(
    $amount,
    $currency,
    $metadata = array(),
    $receipt_email = null,
    $description = '',
    $transfer = array()
)
```

Creates a new payment transaction that might require a customer authentication flow (3DSecure for example)

**Parameters**

+ `$amount` `Integer`: defines the amount of the transaction in cents
+ `$currency` `string`: defines the currecy of the transaction
+ `$metadata` `string`, default `array()`: defines the metadata information that can be passed on to the transaction
+ `$receipt_email` `string`, default `null`: defines the email address where the receipt should be sent
+ `$description` `string`, default `''`: defines a description of the product beind sold
+ `$transfer` `array`, default `array()`: defines the transfer data to vendors if they  exist. keys possible: 'destination' for connected stripe account. 'amount' to define the amount the vendor will receive

**Returns** `$result`: to report on the result of the creation

Source: [framework/core/Payment.php:122](https://github.com/caligrafy/caligrafy-quill/blob/v2.25.0/framework/core/Payment.php#L122)

<a name="payment-createcheckout"></a>
#### `->createCheckout()`

```php
public function createCheckout(
    $amount = 1000,
    $currency = 'usd',
    $quantity = 1,
    $productData = array(),
    $successUrl = '',

    $customerEmail = null,

    $paymentType = null,

)
```

Creates a new integrated checkout session

**Parameters**

+ `$amount` `Integer`, default `1000`: defines the amount of the transaction in cents
+ `$currency` `string`, default `'usd'`: defines the currency of the transaction
+ `$quantity` `string`, default `1`: defines the quantity of products
+ `$productData` `string`, default `array()`: defines the product information that can be passed on to the transaction
+ `$successUrl` `string`, default `''`: defines the url that it will redirect to when successful payment
+ `$cancelUrl` `string`, default `''`: defines the url that it will redirect to when the payment fails
+ `$customerEmail`, default `null`
+ `$locale`, default `null`
+ `$paymentType` `array`, default `null`: defines the different payment methods to be supported by checkout
+ `$payment_intent_data` `array`, default `array()`: . Potential attributes: 'application_fee_amount' for charging vendors
+ `$vendor` `array`, default `array()`: . Potential array keys: 'stripe_account' for the vendor account

**Returns** `$result`: to report on the result of the creation

Source: [framework/core/Payment.php:191](https://github.com/caligrafy/caligrafy-quill/blob/v2.25.0/framework/core/Payment.php#L191)

<a name="cryptopayment"></a>
## class Caligrafy\CryptoPayment

```php
namespace Caligrafy;

class CryptoPayment extends \stdClass
```

Source: [framework/core/CryptoPayment.php:26](https://github.com/caligrafy/caligrafy-quill/blob/v2.25.0/framework/core/CryptoPayment.php#L26)

CryptoPayment accepts crypto payments (USDC) through the Coinbase Business Checkouts API.

Coinbase Commerce (api.commerce.coinbase.com, CRYPTO_PAY_KEY) shut down on March 31, 2026. Its successor is the
Checkouts API of Coinbase Business (https://business.coinbase.com/api/v1/checkouts), available to merchants in the
supported countries. Requests are authenticated with a short-lived JWT signed with a CDP API key:

- COINBASE_API_KEY_NAME: the key name, e.g. organizations/{org_id}/apiKeys/{key_id}
- COINBASE_API_KEY_SECRET: the Ed25519 secret (base64) or the ECDSA private key (PEM, legacy keys)

<a name="cryptopayment-createtransaction"></a>
#### `->createTransaction()`

```php
public function createTransaction(
    $amount,
    $currency,
    $charge = array(),
    $metadata = array(),
    $redirectUrl = '',
    $cancelUrl = '',
    $expiresAt = null
)
```

Creates a hosted checkout (single-use payment page)

**Parameters**

+ `$amount` `string|float`: the amount (2 decimals at most)
+ `$currency` `string`: USDC or a fiat currency (USD, EUR, GBP, SGD...) converted to USDC at creation
+ `$charge` `array`, default `array()`: 'name' and 'description' of the product
+ `$metadata` `array`, default `array()`: up to 20 string pairs
+ `$redirectUrl` `string`, default `''`: HTTPS URL to come back to after a successful payment
+ `$cancelUrl` `string`, default `''`: HTTPS URL to come back to after a failed payment
+ `$expiresAt` `string`, default `null`: RFC 3339 expiration date (default: 24 hours)

**Returns** `array`: ['action_success' =&gt; bool, 'url' =&gt; hosted payment page, 'data' =&gt; checkout (data['hosted_url'] kept for older code)]

Source: [framework/core/CryptoPayment.php:72](https://github.com/caligrafy/caligrafy-quill/blob/v2.25.0/framework/core/CryptoPayment.php#L72)
